headline: TeamViewer Shares Plunge 19% on Q3 Revenue Drop and Cut Outlook
summary: TeamViewer shares plummeted 19% following a decline in third-quarter revenue and a downward revision to its full-year 2026 outlook.
why: Significant cuts to revenue guidance and earnings misses routinely trigger sharp re-pricings in technology equities.

impacts.name: TeamViewer AG
impacts.why: Disappointing third-quarter revenues and a lowered 2026 outlook directly reduce the company's equity valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A reported third-quarter revenue decline combined with a guidance cut forced institutional investors to re-evaluate the company's growth profile.
